purpose: EXPERIMENT.md section 4 step 6: proof-run cost estimates from measured runs, and the explicit agent, compute and evaluation budgets that demand/spec.json carries. Every number states its provenance: measured (a run id), list price (a dated page) or scenario (an assumption).
zeroSpendConstraint: No GPU rental, no PROVE purchase, no paid runner minutes: all proving and execution runs on GitHub-hosted runners of the public repository (free minutes, 6 h job cap, one RPC-bound job at a time). The only real money is the creator's inference; testnet ETH is nominal (ROBINHOOD_CHAIN_PROD.md I-X1).

measuredRunCosts.runner: GitHub-hosted ubuntu-24.04, 4 vCPU, 16 GB, x86_64; wall times are records on a shared machine, not benchmarks

build.note: one variant of the pinned host plus lemma-prove; three variants build in parallel

executeFromRpc.note: witness fetch from the archive provider plus SP1 execute; 0.96M gas 83 s, 28.2M gas 512 to 549 s

executeReplayOrFixture.note: about 80 s is SP1 setup regardless of block size; 28.2M gas executes in 12 s

trieFixtures.note: build of lemma-fixtures plus 31 cases per backend

leanCheck.note: elan install, toolchain download, build, axioms, leanchecker on the smoke project

compressedProof.note: 4 h 09 min with a 24 GB swap file; the 6 h cap bounds proofs to about 30M cycles

groth16Wrap.note: shrink and wrap 1216 s, gnark 233 s

peakResidentSetKb.note: every execute run of step 5; dominated by SP1 setup

archiveRpc.limit: HTTP 429 with more than one concurrent witness fetch (apparatus/FAILURES.md #9); witness generation therefore runs one job at a time
archiveRpc.callsPerWitness: not metered by the host; the dashboard is the only source

modeledProofPrices.basis: Succinct Prover Network list price as quoted in PROOF_MODULE_VALUE.md section 2 from the network quickstart: 0.2 PROVE base fee plus up to 2.0 PROVE per billion PGU; a cap, not a cleared price; nothing is bought at it in this experiment

savingAtThreshold.rule: a candidate exactly at the 5% gate against the arena counterfactual C saves 0.05 * pguC per job
savingAtThreshold.note: the 0.2 PROVE base fee is invariant to any module, so per-job value is small unless blocks are large or volume is high (PROOF_MODULE_VALUE.md section 2)

creatorBudget.model: claude-opus-5 through the Claude Agent SDK (TOOLING.md B2); Sonnet 5 is the fallback if the sponsor cuts the budget before funding, recorded as a spec revision

scenario.note: a three-day run with three local revisions; assumption, not a measurement

limits.tokenLimitDefinition: sum of input, cache-write, cache-read and output tokens reported by the API over every turn of the main run

controls.note: disposition-only, no builds beyond reading the registry snapshot and profiling records

creatorBudget.enforcement: the runner (agent/runner, F2) stops the run at any limit and records the usage that triggered it; the run log carries the API usage per revision; the cost reported in results/report.md is the observed bill, not this estimate

creatorComputeBudget.executeInputs: fixture (the committed corpus) or replay; RPC-backed executions only for the three corpus blocks, none for other blocks, so the creator never fetches state outside the public corpus
creatorComputeBudget.note: public repository minutes are free; the binding limits are the 6 h job cap, one RPC job at a time and the dispatch counts, enforced by the runner's tool allowlist

evaluationBudget.paidBy: operator (EXPERIMENT.md section 8: evaluation infrastructure is separately budgeted)

builds.note: candidate variant B; A and C exist

trieFixtures.note: pointer, arena and the candidate backend

corpusExecutions.note: A, B, C on three development blocks

holdoutWitnessRuns.note: one RPC-backed run per block and variant, sequential

compressedProofs.note: A and B on the smallest holdout block under 30M A cycles, else 20600066 (the A proof of 20600066 exists: run 35018130745, reused rather than regenerated)

humanReview.note: reviewer note on the theorem, verdict signing

evaluationBudget.provingCapCheck: a proof job that would exceed the 6 h cap is not attempted; the report says so and PGU remains the gate (Inconclusive is never produced by a missing proof, since proofs are not the gate)

reuseBudget.cyclesEstimate: about 19M on the baseline guest by gas ratio to 20600066; fits one proof job

proof.note: the third real proof; worker-run, settles on Robinhood Chain testnet

deadlines.rule: measured plan plus margin, relative to the funding block timestamp; absolute Unix values are written into demand/spec.json and the fundDemand call at funding (step 7)

submitBy.derivation: 72 h creator wall budget + 24 h for the runner's confirmation wait, queueing and the submission transaction

evaluateBy.derivation: about 2 elapsed days of sequential runner work + 2 h review + one full retry of the longest stage (a 6 h proof) + margin, rounded up to 5 days

deadlines.calendarCheck: funding on 2026-09-18 gives submitBy 2026-09-22 and evaluateBy 2026-09-27, inside the ROBINHOOD_CHAIN_PROD.md plan (G3 to 23 September, G4 to 28 September) and before the 4 October buildathon deadline

sponsorAmounts.asset: testnet ETH on Robinhood Chain testnet (46630)

usageFee.note: per reuse job, snapshotted at fundJob

sponsorAmounts.label: payment mechanics demonstrated; nominal amounts chosen by the sponsor, no willingness-to-pay claim

walletsToFund.relayer for the evaluator verdict: any funded account; the signature carries the authority

scenarioEconomics.label: scenario, not observed savings (BUILD_CASE_MAP.md M-economic): prices are list prices and the bounty is testnet
scenarioEconomics.creatorExperimentMargin: bounty (testnet, no USD value) + usage fees (testnet) - inference cost (observed, up to 300 USD) - 0 proving cost: negative in USD by construction; the experiment measures whether the loop works, not whether it pays

buyerBreakEvenJobs.formula: ceil((bounty + integration cost) / net saving per job)
buyerBreakEvenJobs.example: a bounty valued at the creator's 300 USD inference cost, integration cost 0, saving 0.0356 PROVE per 28M-gas job at list price: break-even = 300 / (0.0356 * P) = 8427 / P jobs where P is the USD price of one PROVE (8427 jobs at P = 1); at the same gate on 0.96M-gas blocks the saving is 0.0021 PROVE per job and break-even is 142857 / P jobs
buyerBreakEvenJobs.note: PROVE is not converted to USD here; the report converts at the price on the day if it converts at all
